prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1235; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with ongoing right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Over the course of 25 visits, treatment proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory medication, and visit frequency was gradually reduced as symptoms improved. Physical examination revealed positive findings supporting soft tissue involvement, including localized tenderness and effusion, while several other provocative and stability tests returned within normal limits. The patient has no known prior injury or treatment involving this body area. Billing records show two similar charges posted on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy. Patient is progressing well, with improving strength and function, and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise.
